title: Nonlinear Landau damping for the unconfined Vlasov-Poisson system in 2D
summary: We prove nonlinear Landau damping for the two-dimensional Vlasov--Poisson system in the unconfined Euclidean setting near the homogeneous Poisson equilibrium \[ μ(v)=\frac{1}{2π}(1+|v|^2)^{-3/2}. \] For small, smooth, localized, and neutral perturbations we establish global existence, quantitative pointwise decay estimates for the electric field, and scattering to free transport. The result we prove here appears to be the first nonlinear Landau damping result for solution of the unconfined 2D Vlasov--Poisson system.
